To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) ViFS based framework can effectively reduce the intra class variation in gait recognition; (2) CNN feature map is the best feature enhancer for ViFS, while it requires less gallery set to achieve deformation invariant performance; (3) ViFS based frameworks outperform the conventional methods by a large margin (up to 10%) on silhouette quality degradation challenge.
ViFS based frameworks achieve robust gait recognition performance under various conditions, and CNN feature maps can be used to further reduce the gallery size requirement.

the ViFS based framework is robust to gait silhouette holistic variation, and it achieves 99.1%, 97.7%, 95.8% recognition accuracy respectively on CASIA Dataset-B, OU ISIR Large population dataset, and the proposed segmentation quality influenced gait dataset.
